image_description: A close-up, black-and-white (or desaturated) photograph of a ceramic teacup resting on a matching saucer. The cup features a decorative band around the rim with a textured pattern and stylized floral or leaf motifs on the body. A C-shaped handle is visible on the right side. The background is blurred, suggesting a shallow depth of field.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a cup and not a bowl or mug, and to verify material properties.
To ensure the handle is physically connected to the cup body without melting or floating artifacts, a common AI failure mode.
To verify correct spatial grounding between the cup and saucer, checking for clipping or incorrect shadowing.
To detect subtle texture anomalies in the glaze or decorative patterns that might indicate generation artifacts.

focus_areas: Handle attachment points for structural validity
Consistency of decorative patterns (no warping or gibberish)
Contact point between cup base and saucer
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the handle's connection to the cup body; AI often fails here by merging the handle into the wall or leaving a gap. Also, inspect the decorative leaf patterns for logical consistency—do they follow the curvature of the cup naturally, or do they appear pasted on? Check the rim for any irregularities in thickness.
